caption:
US household debt just hit $19.1 trillion. 📊
The New York Fed's Q3 report (out today) says credit card balances are $1.285 trillion, up $22 billion from last quarter.
About 5.0% of all debt is in some stage of delinquency, up 0.3 points.
The bright spot: the flow of card balances into serious delinquency edged down to 6.87% from 7.05% a year ago.
What's the one balance you're working hardest to bring down?
